messages:
Alice M.: Vendor scheduled external assessment Tue 2026-06-02 09:00–13:00 PDT. Need plan for ephemeral RBAC, KMS access for evidence ingestion, auditproof checklist, and retest slots. Who can own what?

Ben I.: I can own RBAC window and role creation. We should scope an 'assessor-ephemeral' role and a short-lived grant for KMS. Need vendor IAM ARNs.

Cara O.: I'll be oncall that day and can monitor. Please add a rollback playbook for immediate revoke. Also call out which telemetry streams to preserve.

Dan S.: CloudTrail + host auditd + application logs are required. Recommend snapshot to S3 nightly and keep a 90d retention minimum. If possible use object lock for evidence immutability. We can provide presigned URLs for upload.

Evan P.: From compliance: vendor should not get long-lived Decrypt rights. Use KMS grants that are time-limited. Prefer not to edit key policy unless unavoidable. Also need KMS usage logging enabled.

Ben I.: We can create a KMS grant scoped to the vendor role. Example CLI to create a grant (vendor role ARN to be filled):

```
aws kms create-grant \
  --key-id alias/redwood-pt \
  --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/vendor-assessor \
  --operations Encrypt Decrypt GenerateDataKey \
  --name "pt-temp-grant"
```

Ben I.: Grant TTL will be enforced by us by calling `retire-grant` after the window ends.

Alice M.: Add RBAC changes to the remediation tracker — include owner, ETA, and evidence link. Tracker URL: https://redwood/secure/pt-remediate/PR-432 (internal).

Cara O.: I'll add tracker columns: vuln_id, severity, owner, PR link, evidence_url, retest_slot. Make retest slots discrete so we can allocate infra.

Dan S.: Reading room access: serve read-only artifacts via presigned S3 URLs expiring 72h. Do not hand out console creds. For live log access, provide a CloudWatch cross-account role with session duration limited to 1 hour.

Evan P.: Ensure CloudTrail records KMS actions (Decrypt, GenerateDataKey). Add an alert if Decrypt spikes beyond baseline during the engagement.

Ben I.: IAM policy sketch for assessor-role (restricts to evidence bucket):

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["s3:GetObject"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence/*"
    },
    {
      "Effect": "Deny",
      "Action": ["s3:DeleteObject"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence/*"
    }
  ]
}
```

Alice M.: Proposed retest windows: next-week Wed 13:00–15:00 UTC and Fri 13:00–15:00 UTC. Vendors typically want 2-hour blocks. Who can staff these?

Cara O.: I can cover Wed. Will monitor telemetry and revoke grants if we see anomalies.

Ben I.: I can cover Fri and will own grant issuance and retirement.

Evan P.: I'll validate evidence packaging format and confirm compliance acceptance. Also confirm whether we need to rotate the KMS key after the engagement.

oncall-bot: Reminder created — "PT: preflight checklist" scheduled 2026-06-01 16:00 PDT. Calendar invite sent to participants.

Ben I.: Question for the group: rotate key post-engagement or not? Compliance usually prefers rotation if external principals had decrypt capability. I recommend rotate and document in the post-engagement playbook.

Alice M.: Agreed. Post-engagement steps to add to playbook: retire grants, revoke any temporary roles, rotate KMS key if vendor used decrypt, export and archive audit logs, and run regression tests on critical endpoints.

Evan P.: I'll draft the minimal runbook and upload to the tracker by EOD. Sample presign command for evidence ingest: `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-pt-evidence/<file> --expires-in 259200` (72h).

Dan S.: Also note: take a CloudTrail snapshot and export to our forensics S3 bucket before the window closes. Tag exports with `pt-engagement:<id>`.

Alice M.: Perfect — next actions: Ben gather vendor ARNs and put IAM/KMS snippets in the tracker; Evan drafts runbook; Cara creates retest slots in calendar; Dan scripts the CloudTrail snapshot job. We'll reconvene in the preflight invite. Thanks all.
